|hatnote=For the Dark Side card, see [[Skiff (Dark)]].
|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Skiff", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (2000). Hansen ranks the Skiff among the better transport vehicles for either side: it deploys -1 to Tatooine sites, carries a driver and up to five passengers who all add their power, moves as a react, and lets everyone aboard disembark if it is lost. Dark Side players can add an [[Antipersonnel Laser Cannon]]. He advises carrying mains and other tough characters on Skiffs to guard exterior sites. "Skiffs can play a powerful role in many decks encompassing ground forces by keeping them highly mobile."<ref name="hansen-neglected14">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles/neglected14.html "Skiff" review], Jeff Hansen, Neglected Card Series, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020128090733/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles/neglected14.html Internet Archive]. Listed on the site's [http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles.html Articles page] by 1 June 2000. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000601012352/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles.html Internet Archive]</ref>
